date_picker/mod.zig.contract: DatePicker captures ControlShell trigger parts and Input time-editor results; capture pins their component roots.

date_range_picker/mod.zig.contract: DateRangePicker captures ControlShell trigger slots before retaining start/end/chevron aliases; capture pins the shell root.

select/mod.zig.contract: Select stores ControlShell parts; capture pins the complete parts.

tags_input/mod.zig.contract: TagsInput captures Input results and the Add Button; Input pins its inner shell and Button capture pins its component root.

input/mod.zig.contract: Input stores ControlShell parts; capture pins the complete parts.

input/textarea.zig.contract: Textarea, including embedded, captures ControlShell parts before retaining surface/selection aliases.

file_upload/mod.zig.contract: FileUploadResult browse_button explicitly pins the retained Button root.

window_chrome/caption.zig.contract: WindowControls explicitly pins retained caption Button roots.

group/mod.zig.contract: Group pins each imperative retained child.

grid/mod.zig.contract: Grid delegates pooled cell scope ownership to view.renderInto.

table/mod.zig.contract: Table delegates cell, virtual row and separator scope ownership to view.renderInto.

virtual_list/mod.zig.contract: VirtualList delegates pooled row scope ownership to view.renderInto.
